# Whereonott - Knowledge Base

> Find where to stream movies and TV shows across global OTT platforms.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- Search Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV+
- Real-time availability
- Trending titles daily
- Genre filtering
- IMDB rating overlay

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://whereonott.online/
